question: A metal wire obeys Hooke's law. When the stretching force applied to it is doubled, its extension becomes
question_ne: एउटा धातुको तारले हुकको नियम पालना गर्छ। त्यसमा लगाइएको तन्काउने बल दोब्बर पारिएमा यसको लम्बाइ वृद्धि कति हुन्छ?
explanation: By Hooke's law, within the elastic limit the extension is directly proportional to the applied force, so doubling the force doubles the extension.
explanation_ne: हुकको नियम अनुसार प्रत्यास्थ सीमाभित्र लम्बाइ वृद्धि लगाइएको बलसँग समानुपातिक हुन्छ, त्यसैले बल दोब्बर हुँदा लम्बाइ वृद्धि पनि दोब्बर हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Young's modulus of a material depends on
question_ne: कुनै पदार्थको यङ मोडुलस कुन कुरामा निर्भर गर्छ?
options: the cross-sectional area of the wire
the material of the wire only
explanation: Young's modulus is a property of the material itself and is independent of the dimensions of the sample or the force applied.
explanation_ne: यङ मोडुलस पदार्थको गुण हो; यो नमुनाको आकार वा लगाइएको बलबाट स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A temperature of 300 K is equal to how many degrees Celsius?
question_ne: ३०० K तापक्रम सेल्सियसमा कति डिग्री हुन्छ?
explanation: Celsius temperature = kelvin temperature − 273, so 300 K = 27 °C.
explanation_ne: सेल्सियस तापक्रम = केल्भिन तापक्रम − २७३, त्यसैले ३०० K = २७ °C हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The triple point of water, used to define the kelvin scale, is
question_ne: केल्भिन मापन परिभाषित गर्न प्रयोग हुने पानीको त्रिक बिन्दु (triple point) कति हो?
explanation: By definition the triple point of water is 273.16 K (0.01 °C), the temperature at which ice, water and vapour coexist.
explanation_ne: परिभाषा अनुसार पानीको त्रिक बिन्दु २७३.१६ K (०.०१ °C) हुन्छ, जहाँ बरफ, पानी र बाफ एकसाथ रहन्छन्।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Steam at 100 °C causes more severe burns than boiling water at the same temperature because steam
question_ne: १०० °C को बाफले सोही तापक्रमको उम्लिरहेको पानीभन्दा बढी गम्भीर पोलेको घाउ किन बनाउँछ?
options: carries extra latent heat of vaporisation
has a lower specific heat capacity
options_ne: बाफमा वाष्पीकरणको गुप्त ताप थप हुन्छ
बाफको विशिष्ट ताप क्षमता कम हुन्छ
explanation: When steam condenses on the skin it releases its latent heat of vaporisation in addition to the heat of the hot water, so it delivers much more heat.
explanation_ne: बाफले छालामा ठोसिँदा वाष्पीकरणको गुप्त ताप पनि छोड्छ, त्यसैले यसले उम्लिरहेको पानीभन्दा बढी ताप दिन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The critical angle for light travelling from glass of refractive index 1.5 into air is about
question_ne: अपवर्तनाङ्क १.५ भएको काँचबाट हावामा जाने प्रकाशको क्रान्तिक कोण लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation: sin C = 1/n = 1/1.5 = 0.667, so the critical angle C is about 41.8°.
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A ray of light travelling from water (refractive index 4/3) to air suffers total internal reflection when its angle of incidence exceeds
question_ne: पानी (अपवर्तनाङ्क ४/३) बाट हावामा जाने प्रकाश किरणले आफ्नो आपतन कोण कति नाघेपछि पूर्ण आन्तरिक परावर्तन हुन्छ?
explanation: sin C = 3/4 = 0.75, so the critical angle is about 48.6°; beyond this angle total internal reflection occurs.
explanation_ne: sin C = ३/४ = ०.७५, त्यसैले क्रान्तिक कोण C ≈ ४८.६° हुन्छ; यसभन्दा ठूलो आपतन कोणमा पूर्ण आन्तरिक परावर्तन हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: An object is placed 30 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 20 cm. The image is formed at a distance of
question_ne: एउटा वस्तु २० सेमी फोकस दूरी भएको उत्तल लेन्सको अगाडि ३० सेमी दूरीमा राखिएको छ। प्रतिबिम्ब कति दूरीमा बन्छ?
explanation: From the lens formula, 1/v = 1/f − 1/u = 1/20 − 1/30 = 1/60, so v = 60 cm.
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The power of a lens of focal length −25 cm is
question_ne: फोकस दूरी −२५ सेमी भएको लेन्सको क्षमता (power) कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Power P = 100/f(cm) = 100/(−25) = −4 dioptres; the negative sign shows it is a concave lens.
explanation_ne: क्षमता P = १००/f(सेमी) = १००/(−२५) = −४ डायोप्टर हुन्छ; ऋणात्मक चिह्नले यो अवतल लेन्स हो भन्ने देखाउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: For a prism of refracting angle 60°, the angle of minimum deviation is 30°. The refractive index of the prism material is
question_ne: ६०° अपवर्तक कोण भएको प्रिज्ममा न्यूनतम विचलन कोण ३०° छ। प्रिज्मको पदार्थको अपवर्तनाङ्क कति हो?
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: In a prism, the angle of deviation is minimum when the ray
question_ne: प्रिज्ममा विचलन कोण न्यूनतम कहिले हुन्छ?
options_ne: किरण प्रिज्मबाट सममित रूपमा पार हुँदा
explanation: At minimum deviation the angle of incidence equals the angle of emergence, so the ray passes symmetrically through the prism.
explanation_ne: न्यूनतम विचलनमा आपतन कोण र निर्गमन कोण बराबर हुन्छन्, अर्थात् किरण प्रिज्मबाट सममित रूपमा पार हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Two waves of amplitudes 3 units and 4 units superpose in phase. The amplitude of the resultant wave is
question_ne: ३ एकाइ र ४ एकाइ आयाम भएका दुई तरङ्गहरू समान कलामा अध्यारोपित हुन्छन्। परिणामी तरङ्गको आयाम कति हुन्छ?
explanation: In phase, the amplitudes add: 3 + 4 = 7 units (constructive interference).
explanation_ne: समान कलामा आयामहरू जोडिन्छन्: ३ + ४ = ७ एकाइ हुन्छ (रचनात्मक व्यतिकरण)।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: When two identical waves meet in opposite phase, the resultant amplitude is
question_ne: दुई समान तरङ्गहरू विपरीत कलामा भेटिँदा परिणामी आयाम कति हुन्छ?
explanation: In opposite phase the waves cancel each other exactly, so the resultant amplitude is zero (destructive interference).
explanation_ne: विपरीत कलामा तरङ्गहरूले एकअर्कालाई रद्द गर्छन्, त्यसैले परिणामी आयाम शून्य हुन्छ (विनाशकारी व्यतिकरण)।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The speed of sound in air increases by about how much for every 1 °C rise in temperature?
question_ne: तापक्रम १ °C बढ्दा हावामा ध्वनिको गति लगभग कतिले बढ्छ?
explanation: The speed of sound in air rises with temperature by about 0.61 m/s for each 1 °C increase.
explanation_ne: हावामा ध्वनिको गति तापक्रमसँग बढ्छ — प्रत्येक १ °C वृद्धिमा लगभग ०.६१ मि/से बढ्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A sound wave of frequency 500 Hz travels in air at 340 m/s. Its wavelength is
question_ne: ५०० हर्ज आवृत्ति भएको ध्वनि तरङ्ग हावामा ३४० मि/से गतिमा यात्रा गर्छ। यसको तरङ्गदैर्ध्य कति हो?
explanation: Wavelength λ = v/f = 340/500 = 0.68 m.
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A wire of resistance 12 Ω is cut into three equal parts and the parts are connected in parallel. The equivalent resistance is
question_ne: १२ Ω प्रतिरोध भएको तारलाई तीन बराबर भागमा काटेर ती भागहरूलाई समानान्तर जोडिन्छ। तुल्य प्रतिरोध कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Each part has resistance 4 Ω; three 4 Ω resistors in parallel give 4/3 ≈ 1.33 Ω.
explanation_ne: प्रत्येक भाग ४ Ω को हुन्छ; तीनवटा ४ Ω समानान्तरमा जोड्दा तुल्य प्रतिरोध ४/३ ≈ १.३३ Ω हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The resistance of a metal wire increases with temperature because
question_ne: धातुको तारको प्रतिरोध तापक्रमसँगै किन बढ्छ?
options: the number of free electrons decreases
the lattice ions vibrate more and collide with electrons more often
the electrons move faster and escape
options_ne: जालक आयनहरू बढी कम्पन गर्छन् र इलेक्ट्रोनहरूसँग बढी ठोक्किन्छन्
explanation: At higher temperatures the lattice ions vibrate with larger amplitude, causing more frequent collisions with the drifting electrons and so higher resistance.
explanation_ne: उच्च तापक्रममा जालक आयनहरू बढी कम्पन गर्छन्, जसले इलेक्ट्रोनहरूसँग बढी ठक्कर गराउँछ र प्रतिरोध बढाउँछ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Two tuning forks of frequencies 256 Hz and 260 Hz are sounded together. The beat frequency heard is
question_ne: २५६ हर्ज र २६० हर्ज आवृत्ति भएका दुई स्वरित्र सँगै बजाइन्छन्। सुनिने विस्पन्द आवृत्ति कति हो?
explanation: Beat frequency equals the difference of the two frequencies: 260 − 256 = 4 Hz.
explanation_ne: विस्पन्द आवृत्ति दुई आवृत्तिहरूको भिन्नता बराबर हुन्छ: २६० − २५६ = ४ हर्ज।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A tuning fork produces 5 beats per second with a standard fork of 320 Hz. When a little wax is added to the unknown fork, the beat frequency falls to 3 per second. The frequency of the unknown fork is
question_ne: एउटा स्वरित्रले ३२० हर्जको मानक स्वरित्रसँग प्रति सेकेन्ड ५ विस्पन्द उत्पन्न गर्छ। अज्ञात स्वरित्रमा अलिकति मोम थप्दा विस्पन्द आवृत्ति प्रति सेकेन्ड ३ मा झर्छ। अज्ञात स्वरित्रको आवृत्ति कति हो?
explanation: The unknown frequency is 315 Hz or 325 Hz. Wax lowers the frequency; since the beats decreased, the frequency moved towards 320 Hz, so it was originally 325 Hz.
explanation_ne: अज्ञात आवृत्ति ३१५ वा ३२५ हर्ज हुन सक्छ। मोमले आवृत्ति घटाउँछ; विस्पन्द घट्नु भनेको आवृत्ति ३२० तिर सरेको हो, त्यसैले सुरुको आवृत्ति ३२५ हर्ज थियो।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The work done in moving a charge of 2 C between two points having a potential difference of 12 V is
question_ne: १२ V विभवान्तर भएका दुई बिन्दुहरूबीच २ C आवेश सार्न कति कार्य गर्नुपर्छ?
explanation: Work done W = qV = 2 × 12 = 24 J.
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The electric potential at a point 0.2 m away from a point charge of 4 nC in air is
question_ne: हावामा ४ nC बिन्दु आवेशबाट ०.२ मि टाढाको बिन्दुमा विद्युत् विभव कति हुन्छ?
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A parallel-plate capacitor has capacitance C. If the separation between the plates is halved, its capacitance becomes
question_ne: समानान्तर प्लेट धारित्रको धारिता C छ। प्लेटहरूबीचको दूरी आधा गरिएमा यसको धारिता कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Capacitance C = ε₀A/d is inversely proportional to the plate separation, so halving d doubles C.
explanation_ne: धारिता C = ε₀A/d भएकाले दूरी आधा हुँदा धारिता दोब्बर हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Two capacitors of 6 μF and 3 μF are connected in series. Their equivalent capacitance is
question_ne: ६ μF र ३ μF का दुई धारित्र श्रेणीमा जोडिएका छन्। तिनीहरूको तुल्य धारिता कति हो?
explanation: In series, 1/C = 1/6 + 1/3 = 1/2, so C = 2 μF.
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: The magnetic susceptibility of a diamagnetic substance is
question_ne: प्रतिचुम्बकीय (diamagnetic) पदार्थको चुम्बकीय प्रवृत्ति कस्तो हुन्छ?
explanation: Diamagnetic materials weakly oppose an applied magnetic field, so their susceptibility is small and negative.
explanation_ne: प्रतिचुम्बकीय पदार्थहरूले लागु चुम्बकीय क्षेत्रलाई कमजोर रूपमा विरोध गर्छन्, त्यसैले तिनीहरूको प्रवृत्ति सानो र ऋणात्मक हुन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Above the Curie temperature, a ferromagnetic material becomes
question_ne: क्युरी तापक्रमभन्दा माथि, लौहचुम्बकीय (ferromagnetic) पदार्थ के बन्छ?
explanation: Above the Curie temperature, thermal agitation destroys the alignment of magnetic domains and the material becomes paramagnetic.
explanation_ne: क्युरी तापक्रमभन्दा माथि तापीय उत्तेजनाले चुम्बकीय डोमेनहरूको पङ्क्तिबद्धता नष्ट गर्छ र पदार्थ अनुचुम्बकीय बन्छ।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Which of the following is a derived SI unit?
question_ne: निम्नमध्ये कुन व्युत्पन्न SI एकाइ हो?
explanation: The joule (unit of work and energy) is derived from base units, whereas the metre, kilogram and second are base SI units.

source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: One electron-volt (1 eV) is equal to
question_ne: एक इलेक्ट्रोन-भोल्ट (१ eV) बराबर कति हुन्छ?
explanation: 1 eV = 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ C × 1 V = 1.6×10⁻¹⁹ J, the energy gained by an electron crossing a 1 V potential difference.

question: Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 6 Ω are connected in parallel. The equivalent resistance is
question_ne: २ Ω, ३ Ω र ६ Ω का तीन प्रतिरोधक समानान्तरमा जोडिएका छन्। तुल्य प्रतिरोध कति हो?
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: Resistors of 4 Ω and 12 Ω are connected in parallel across a battery. The ratio of the current through the 4 Ω resistor to that through the 12 Ω resistor is
question_ne: ४ Ω र १२ Ω का प्रतिरोधकहरू ब्याट्रीमा समानान्तर जोडिएका छन्। ४ Ω प्रतिरोधकबाट बग्ने धारा र १२ Ω प्रतिरोधकबाट बग्ने धाराको अनुपात कति हो?
explanation: In parallel the voltage is the same, so current is inversely proportional to resistance: (1/4):(1/12) = 3:1.
explanation_ne: समानान्तरमा भोल्टेज बराबर हुन्छ, त्यसैले धारा प्रतिरोधको व्युत्क्रमानुपातिक हुन्छ: (१/४):(१/१२) = ३:१।
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: An alternating current has a peak value of 10 A. Its RMS value is
question_ne: एउटा प्रत्यावर्ती धाराको शिखर मान १० A छ। यसको RMS मान कति हो?
explanation: RMS value = peak value/√2 = 10/1.414 ≈ 7.07 A.
source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: An AC voltmeter connected to the mains reads 220 V. The peak value of the mains voltage is about
question_ne: मेनमा जोडिएको AC भोल्टमिटरले २२० V देखाउँछ। मेन भोल्टेजको शिखर मान लगभग कति हो?
explanation: AC meters read the RMS value; the peak value is 220 × √2 ≈ 311 V.

question: The charge carried by an alpha particle is
question_ne: अल्फा कणले कति आवेश बोक्छ?

source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: An alpha particle is composed of
question_ne: अल्फा कण के-के मिलेर बनेको हुन्छ?
explanation: An alpha particle is a helium-4 nucleus, containing 2 protons and 2 neutrons.

source: Outrank model questions — CTEVT Health Sciences First Year

question: A radioactive sample has a half-life of 5 days. After 20 days, the fraction of the original sample remaining is
